about_the_game:
Building beautiful cities has never been simpler in this charming design game. Place blocks on an organic grid to form buildings, parks, trees and water. Combine multiple types of blocks to create everything from charming plazas to sprawling cities. Customize colors, doors, roofs, towers and more. Find unique interactions between blocks, and recruit villagers and animals to your city. Relax and experience the joy of creation in this cozy city builder.

Build and Customize

Change colors and styles on the fly. Add doors and bridges. Raise up towers and spires. On an organic grid each structure has its own distinct features. 

Find Combinations and Special Features

Build walls over roads and water to form gates. Form neighborhoods of houses surrounded by plazas and trees. Drag canals over cliffs to make waterfalls. Decorate your parks with trees and fountains.

A World to Discover

Attract new residents to your city, who offer their own ideas and needs. Unlock new biomes, maps and block types by completing building objectives. Or take a break from construction and explore. Watch animals roam across the land, follow residents as they go about their day, or take to the skies in Bird Mode.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 11
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Additional Notes: A mouse with a scroll wheel and button is needed for full camera control.

name: Belle Citique

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: 2 GHz Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: A mouse with a scroll wheel and button is needed for full camera control.

short_description: Belle Citique is a cozy city builder and design game. Use the joyfully simple building system to make riverside hamlets, alpine castles, bustling cities, and everything in between. No major objectives or obstacles, just sit back and create something beautiful.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese
